posts.linkedin:
Many small business ads on Instagram look exactly like the same template everyone else uses.

A café owner or a clinic receptionist spends hours designing a static image for a Facebook ad. The text is small, the colors match a free template, and the offer blends into the feed. Customers scroll past without stopping because the image looks like every other local business they saw that morning, whether it sells sarees, samosas or sessions.

I build short animated ads for small businesses anywhere in India to use on Instagram and Facebook. It is a short animated video made for Instagram and Facebook. It shows an offer or service in a few seconds with motion and text. It can be used as an ad, a reel or a story. It is sized and paced for a phone screen, so it does not need a camera crew or a studio.

First, the owner tells me what the business sells and what customers keep asking. Then I build the animation using plain motion and text. After that, the owner reviews it and asks for changes. The client pays only after approving the work.

A moving clip can catch the eye faster than a still image. Customers can read the offer while waiting for a bus or during a break. The business gets a piece of creative that feels like its own instead of a copy of a template, and it can be reused across a week of posts.

This works best for businesses that already have a clear offer to show. It does not replace a personal reply to complicated questions, and it does not fix a product or service that customers do not want. It is one part of how a business shows up online.

I am happy to talk through whether this fits your business, and payment happens only after you approve the final clip. DM ADS and tell me what you sell. 🙂
